en:
Fuck off! It'll be 10,000 years before I allow
a bitch-monkey like you to address me!

Until you evolve into an actual human, just
shut the fuck up!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time sitting next to Miu in
silence, just like she ordered me to...
<CLT=cltMIND>What compelled me to obey her like that?
<CLT=cltMIND>Miu and I grew a little closer today.
